name: Ikegami
tagline: Shinagawa in 24 minutes and Shibuya in 38 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Ota City, served by Tokyu Ikegami Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 44 minutes to Otemachi, 46 minutes to Shinjuku, 38 minutes to Shibuya and 24 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 4.3 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 1.5 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 4.3 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 3.9 m to 5.4 m, a difference of 1.5 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 9 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 1 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 11 clinics and 4 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 松和会池上総合病院, about 3 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 池上幸仁診療所, about 10 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyu Ikegami Line.
congestion: Tokyu Ikegami Line runs at 130% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 大崎広小路→五反田, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000 and 1K ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. 1LDK ¥140,000 to ¥150,000 and 2LDK ¥190,000 to ¥200,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Hasunuma is ahead on how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: About 1 km away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Ikegami. One-room rents run about ¥6,000 higher.

neighbours.lead: Chidoricho is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and quiet, but Ikegami is ahead on the number of medical facilities.
neighbours.note: About 1 km away in a straight line. It takes 3 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Ikegami.

goodFor: People who get around by bicycle or with a pushchair
People living alone who want to hold the rent down
notFor: People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
People who want another route when service is suspended
noiseSources: 池上通り (1 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 7 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The number of points that fall inside the projected inundation area is about average for a station in the 23 wards.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyu Ikegami Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: Whether a flat faces the road changes what you hear indoors.
